subject: english
stem: Which sentence correctly denies a past location?
options: Leo did not at school yesterday.
Leo is not at school yesterday.
Leo were no at school yesterday.
Leo was not at school yesterday.

optionRationales.reason: Leo did not at school yesterday.：缺少位置句需要的 be。
Leo is not at school yesterday.：現在 be 與過去時間不合。
Leo were no at school yesterday.：數與否定形式皆錯。
Leo was not at school yesterday.：was not 否定過去位置。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依陳述是否肯定某狀態或否定某狀態，在正確 be 後加入 not，並保持縮寫與原意一致。」可推出 Leo was not at school yesterday.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Leo was not at school yesterday. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
